svg.title: A Knot With No Inside
svg.desc: Six projected periodic ribbons have strongly extrapolated phase twist and layer separation. These are the native planar curve model and synthetic depth shading: overlapping bands create apparent crossings without claiming a true three-dimensional Boy surface. Native toolbar flow: nested path echoes → six displaced ribbon immersions.
